title: Agent definition
description: One agent as the person defines it in first-run setup. This is a specification: bloom renders the setup, seed records the definition, and drosera supplies the tools. The autonomy level is required and has no default anywhere, because the person chooses it.

id.description: Stable identifier, unique within the person's user data.

displayName.description: The name the person gives the agent. Theirs, not ours.

character.description: Short description of who the agent is, in the person's words.

job.description: What the agent is for: the work it should take on.

workflowStyle.description: simple hides the machinery; advanced shows plans, tool calls, and settings as the work runs.

autonomy.description: Required, with no default. 'chosen-in-setup' is the placeholder an example carries until the person picks a level; it is not a level a running agent can hold.

level.description: 1 Ask me first, 2 Work alongside, 3 Check in, 4 Handle it, 5 Run in the background. Never preselected.

overrides.description: A per-action-class level, for people who want to answer differently by kind of action. The five classes are the ones the design brief uses: read, reversible write, external or irreversible, spend, and credential. Credentials ask at every level.

questions.description: How the agent reaches the person with a question.

delivery.description: inbox holds questions for when the person returns; inline asks in the moment; digest batches them.

quietHours.description: Local times when nothing may interrupt.

modelRoutes.description: Ordered routes to a model. Kinds only: no keys, no endpoints, no account details.

contextRoutes.description: Where the agent may read from. The web app reaches device context only through these opt-in routes.

toolGrants.description: Tool faces the agent may use, by drosera tool identifier.

memoryScope.description: What the agent may keep, and who else can see it.

standingRules.description: Short rules the person set for this agent, in their own words.

packs.description: Cookbook packs the agent starts with.
